categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: automotive components and integrated mechanical components. Automotive components include interior mechanical parts for vehicles, while integrated mechanical components cover wearable products, smart lock modules, network optical mechanical parts, and gaming device products. The company serves global customers in automotive, 3C electronics, smart home, and wearable device industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies integrating rubber, plastic, optical, film materials, and glass to design and manufacture mechanical components. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including precision molding, multi-material integration, low-temperature vacuum sputtering for plastic metallization, and modular keypads with backlighting. The company also focuses on environmentally friendly materials and processes compliant with RoHS and other regulations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global leading manufacturers and OEMs in automotive, consumer electronics (3C), smart home security, and wearable device sectors. The company supplies automotive interior parts, optical mechanical modules for network and wearable devices, and smart lock modules. Major markets include automotive electronics, smart home monitoring/security devices, and wearable technology.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases in Taiwan, Malaysia (Penang and Kuala Lumpur), and China (Shenzhen). Sales and service networks cover the Americas, Europe, Asia, and other regions. It maintains close customer relationships in these regions and adapts production capacity accordingly.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on design, manufacturing, and assembly of mechanical and optical components and modules. It integrates upstream raw materials like plastics, silicone, glass, and metals into finished components supplied to OEMs and system integrators downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing core competencies through new materials and manufacturing processes, expanding automotive component competitiveness, and developing integrated mechanical-electronic-optical modules for cross-industry applications. The company invests in R&D for environmentally friendly materials, precision molds, multi-material integration, and smart product design, aiming to provide high value-added, customized solutions. Collaboration with FDK Corporation post-acquisition is a key growth driver.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of automotive parts, integrated mechanical modules, and optical components. The company also provides early-stage product design and development services to customers, supporting customized solutions. Revenue is derived from global sales to OEMs and contract manufacturers in automotive, consumer electronics, and smart home sectors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global automotive component suppliers and 3C mechanical module manufacturers, including firms specializing in automotive HMI and smart device components. It positions itself as a high-value, precision component supplier with strong R&D capabilities and global production footprint, differentiating through integrated multi-material technologies and customer-centric design services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.41 billion, a 15.8% increase from the prior year. Operating profit margins declined due to increased costs and operational adjustments, with net profit after tax at NT$55 million. The company maintains a stable financial base with total assets around NT$3.63 billion and equity of NT$2.73 billion, investing steadily in R&D and capital expenditures to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated design and manufacturing capabilities combining rubber, plastic, optical, and electronic components to deliver high-quality, customized mechanical modules. It offers early joint product design, flexible production capacity, and compliance with environmental standards, providing customers with high value-added, ergonomic, and aesthetically diverse products. Its global production and supply chain management enable responsive service and competitive cost advantages.
